name: tolsey
description: A food safety log for small restaurant kitchens that you fill in by voice.
author: voyagi

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/deploy-preflight.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && node scripts/check-remote-migrations.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.gate:types: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.gate:repo: node scripts/check-goals.mjs && node scripts/check-tracked-gitignore.mjs && node scripts/check-hookspath.mjs && node scripts/check-license.mjs && node scripts/check-git-identity.mjs && node scripts/check-artifact-metadata.mjs && node scripts/check-privacy-accountability.mjs --require && node scripts/check-ai-act.mjs --require && node scripts/check-icon-decision.mjs
scripts.gate:precommit: eslint . && jscpd . && npm run gate:env && npm run gate:tsconfig && npm run gate:artifacts && vitest run --project unit
scripts.gate: npm run gate:artifacts && npm run gate:tsconfig && npm run gate:types && npm run gate:complexity && npm run gate:dup && npm run gate:deps && npm run gate:env && npm run gate:size && npm run gate:dead && npm run gate:selftest
scripts.gate:selftest: node scripts/check-test-count.mjs --selftest && node scripts/mutate-incremental.mjs --selftest && node scripts/check-ai-act.mjs --selftest && node scripts/check-privacy-accountability.mjs --selftest
